grammar.pattern: 通常 / 往往 / 总 / 总是
grammar.purpose: Describe usual patterns and repeated behaviour
grammar.explanation: 通常 presents the usual situation with possible exceptions. 往往 emphasizes a tendency, often linked to circumstances. 总/总是 describes recurring behaviour and may be emphatic rather than a mathematically proved every-time claim. 他总忘记带水 is a conversational complaint, not a measured score. Distinguish habitual 总是 from 已经 for completion and 一直 for continuation.

examples.zh: 我们通常周末散步，但这周休息。
examples.py: wǒ men tōng cháng zhōu mò sàn bù , dàn zhè zhōu xiū xī .
examples.en: We usually walk at weekends, but rest this week.

examples.zh: 天气暖和时，她往往出去走走。
examples.py: tiān qì nuǎn huo shí , tā wǎng wǎng chū qù zǒu zǒu .
examples.en: When it is warm, she tends to go for a walk.

examples.zh: 她总是先问朋友有没有空。
examples.py: tā zǒng shì xiān wèn péng you yǒu méi yǒu kōng .

commonMistakes.wrong: 通常去，所以这周一定去了。
commonMistakes.why: A usual pattern allows an exception.

grammar.pattern: 动词 + 时量补语：持续多久
grammar.purpose: Place duration correctly with actions and objects
grammar.explanation: 走了二十分钟 describes a completed interval. 看书看了二十分钟 / 看了二十分钟书 both place duration with the action. 我学汉语学了两年了 normally presents an interval continuing to now; 我学了两年汉语 does not alone establish that it continues. Wait-duration 等了二十分钟 also does not prove the other person arrived. Do not treat a duration as a clock time.

examples.py: wǒ men zǒu le èr shí fēn zhōng .
tā kàn shū kàn le bàn gè xiǎo shí .
examples.en: She read for half an hour.

examples.zh: 我等了二十分钟，她还没到。
examples.py: wǒ děng le èr shí fēn zhōng , tā hái méi dào .
examples.en: I waited twenty minutes; she has not arrived yet.

commonMistakes.why: Use the verb-duration construction, not an unanchored time fragment.

reading.blurb: An original scene written for this course.

lines.zh: 今天我连续开了三个会，午饭也是坐在电脑前吃的。晚上吃完饭，林安问我要不要去散步，我觉得困，差点说不去。
lines.py: jīn tiān wǒ lián xù kāi le sān gè huì , wǔ fàn yě shì zuò zài diàn nǎo qián chī de . wǎn shang chī wán fàn , lín ān wèn wǒ yào bù yào qù sàn bù , wǒ jué de kùn , chà diǎn shuō bù qù .
lines.en: I had three meetings in a row today and ate lunch at the computer too. After dinner Lin An suggested a walk. I was sleepy and nearly said no.

lines.zh: 她说不用跑，出去走二十分钟就回来。我拿了一件薄外套，跟她去河边。路上还有人推着自行车，慢慢往家走。
lines.py: tā shuō bù yòng pǎo , chū qù zǒu èr shí fēn zhōng jiù huí lái . wǒ ná le yī jiàn báo wài tào , gēn tā qù hé biān . lù shàng hái yǒu rén tuī zhe zì xíng chē , màn màn wǎng jiā zǒu .
lines.en: She said we wouldn't run; just twenty minutes out and back. I took a light jacket and followed her to the river. Other people were wheeling bicycles slowly home.

lines.zh: 我们走到桥边停了一会儿。水面上有灯的光，风也不冷。我终于不想一直看手机了，就把它放进了口袋。
lines.py: wǒ men zǒu dào qiáo biān tíng le yī huì er . shuǐ miàn shàng yǒu dēng de guāng , fēng yě bù lěng . wǒ zhōng yú bù xiǎng yì zhí kàn shǒu jī le , jiù bǎ tā fàng jìn le kǒu dài .
lines.en: We stopped by the bridge. Lights shone on the water and the breeze wasn't cold. I finally stopped wanting to stare at my phone and put it in my pocket.

lines.zh: 林安说她通常晚饭后出来走走，往往在这里碰见邻居。话刚说完，就有人叫她的名字，还问旁边的我是不是新来的朋友。
lines.py: lín ān shuō tā tōng cháng wǎn fàn hòu chū lái zǒu zǒu , wǎng wǎng zài zhè lǐ pèng jiàn lín jū . huà gāng shuō wán , jiù yǒu rén jiào tā de míng zi , hái wèn páng biān de wǒ shì bú shì xīn lái de péng you .
lines.en: Lin An said she usually walked after dinner and often met neighbours here. Just then someone called her name and asked if I was a new friend.

lines.zh: 我们聊了几句，就往回走。到家一看，出门整整二十分钟。林安问我还困不困，我说不困了，不过想喝点水。
lines.py: wǒ men liáo le jǐ jù , jiù wǎng huí zǒu . dào jiā yī kàn , chū mén zhěng zhěng èr shí fēn zhōng . lín ān wèn wǒ hái kùn bù kùn , wǒ shuō bù kùn le , bù guò xiǎng hē diǎn shuǐ .
lines.en: We chatted briefly and headed back. We'd been out for exactly twenty minutes. Lin An asked if I was still sleepy. No, but I'd like some water.

lines.zh: 她把水倒好，问明天还去吗。我说去，钥匙已经放在门边了。这次不用再找半天。
lines.py: tā bǎ shuǐ dào hǎo , wèn míng tiān hái qù ma . wǒ shuō qù , yào shi yǐ jīng fàng zài mén biān le . zhè cì bù yòng zài zhǎo bàn tiān .
lines.en: She poured water and asked if I'd go again tomorrow. Yes, I said; my keys were already by the door. No long search this time.

lines.en: We'll go for a walk by the river after dinner.

lines.py: wǔ fàn yě yào zhù yì yíng yǎng .

lines.py: wǒ yǒu diǎn kùn , xiān huí jiā le .

lines.py: zuó wǎn shuì de wǎn , xiàn zài hěn kùn .
